summary: `delivery_git.py` `revise-unclaimed-scope`, `cancel-delivery`, `prepare-pr-creation`, `record-pr-remote`, `open-pr`, `invalidate-delivery-review`, `reopen-item` and `pause-item` now refuse a protocol-1 project Fence with `DELIVERY_PROTOCOL_UNSUPPORTED` and name `upgrade-fence-v1` before any ref or provider write.
